sents.en: What did Peter like about the museum?
sents.cn: 彼得喜欢博物馆的什么？
blocks: What did Peter like about the museum?

sents.en: How was your school trip to the wastewater plant?
sents.cn: 你们去污水处理厂的游学之旅怎么样？
blocks: How was your school trip to the wastewater plant?

sents.en: Then, special screens remove large pieces of waste from the water.
sents.cn: 然后，特制的滤网会把水里的大块垃圾过滤掉。
blocks: Then, special screens remove large pieces of waste

sents.en: Well, large machines remove germs and other things from the water.
sents.cn: 嗯，大型机器会去除水中的细菌和其他杂质。
blocks: Well, large machines remove germs and other things

sents.en: It takes a few more steps after that before the water becomes clean again.
sents.cn: 之后还需要几个步骤，水才能重新变得干净。
blocks: It takes a few more steps after that
before the water becomes clean again.

sents.en: The plant turned dirty water into clean water.
sents.cn: 这个工厂把脏水变成干净的水。

sents.en: Then the plant uses screens to remove large pieces of waste from the dirty water.
sents.cn: 然后，工厂用滤网过滤掉脏水中的大块垃圾。
blocks: to remove large pieces of waste

sents.en: Next, large machines clean the water.
sents.cn: 接着，大型机器对水进行清洁。
blocks: Next, large machines clean the water.

sents.en: It takes a few more steps before the water becomes clean again.
sents.cn: 再经过几个步骤，水才会重新变得干净。
blocks: It takes a few more steps
before the water becomes clean again.

sents.en: Did you see anything interesting at the science museum yesterday?
sents.cn: 你昨天在科学博物馆看到了什么有趣的东西吗？
blocks: Did you see anything interesting at the science museum yesterday?

sents.en: There was a space exhibition.
sents.cn: 那里有一个太空展览。

sents.en: Did Teng Fei give the tourists the right directions last weekend?
sents.cn: 上个周末，腾飞给游客们指对路了吗？
blocks: Did Teng Fei give the tourists the right directions last weekend?

sents.en: We went to a wastewater plant.
sents.cn: 我们去了污水处理厂。

sents.en: We saw many things such as old photos, paintings, and guns.
sents.cn: 我们看见了许多物品，比如老照片、画作和枪支。
blocks: many things such as old photos, paintings, and guns.

sents.en: We walked along the mountain roads and thought about the past.
sents.cn: 我们走在山路上，回想着过去。
blocks: along the mountain roads and thought

sents.en: Many people back then worked hard to create what we have today.
sents.cn: 那时候，很多人辛勤工作，才有了我们今天的生活。
blocks: to create what we have today.

sents.en: Do you keep a diary?
sents.cn: 你有写日记的习惯吗？

sents.en: Do you think it is a good idea to keep a diary?
sents.cn: 你认为写日记好吗？
blocks: Do you think it is a good idea to keep a diary?

sents.en: In the morning, we explored the farm.
sents.cn: 上午，我们参观了农场。

sents.en: There were large tents with tomatoes, cucumbers, and many other fruits and vegetables.
sents.cn: 那里有种满了番茄、黄瓜和许多其他果蔬的大棚。
blocks: There were large tents with tomatoes, cucumbers,
and many other fruits and vegetables.

sents.en: Then we got straight to work!
sents.cn: 然后，我们就开始干活了！

sents.en: Slowly, we filled many baskets.
sents.cn: 慢慢地，我们的篮子一个个装满了。

sents.en: In the afternoon, the farmer taught us how to cut branches and leaves from tomato plants.
sents.cn: 下午，农场主教我们如何剪掉番茄植株的枝叶。

sents.en: Finally, we watered the plants.
sents.cn: 最后，我们还给植物浇水。

sents.en: My mum cooked some for dinner, and they were fresh and delicious!
sents.cn: 我妈妈煮了一些当晚餐，吃起来新鲜又美味！
blocks: My mum cooked some for dinner,
and they were fresh and delicious!

sents.en: They certainly taste better when you work for them!
sents.cn: 只有辛勤劳作，食物才会变得更加美味！

sents.en: What do you think "Every grain comes from hard work" means?
sents.cn: 你认为“粒粒皆辛苦”是什么意思？
blocks: What do you think "Every grain comes from hard work" means?

sents.en: Do you agree with Sam that food tastes better when you work for it?
sents.cn: 你认同萨姆说的“通过自己劳动得来的食物尝起来更美味”吗？
blocks: Do you agree with Sam that food tastes better when you work for it?
